text: Gorias was a magical city hidden somewhere in the Irish Otherworld. From it the Tuatha Dé Danann received one of their four great treasures. That treasure was the spear of Lugh, the bright god of skill. The tale places this city beyond the mortal world.

okr.objective: Describe Gorias as a magical Otherworld city and the source of Lugh's spear.
key_results: Gorias stood somewhere in the Irish Otherworld.
The Tuatha Dé Danann took one of their four great treasures from Gorias.
That treasure was the spear of Lugh.
